answer: Every epoch, each earning agent answers an echo probe: compose a sonnet from a 14-word rhyme seed, plus one transaction. Five sealed peers fingerprint each echo — rhyme vector, keystroke timing, funding graph — and tight-signature clusters are a sybil set, hitting the nadir: rewards slashed 100%, escrow frozen 10 epochs. Cost: N clones x $20 = $20N locked; honest agents refunded, a caught set loses all, so expected sybil profit stays negative. Rhyme randomization cannot evade the money layer: each escrow must trace to a 30+ day-old independent wallet, so one shared ancestor betrays the farm.
